sources.title: Jets DC Brian Duker on Ashton Jeanty's comments: Plenty of confidence in our guys
sources.description: Raiders running back Ashton Jeanty took a shot at the Jets defense from Las Vegas ahead of this Sunday's game between the teams and it was heard in New Jersey.
